The '''Demurra Trench''' was a deep, difficult to navigate trench on the floor of the [[Belsallian Sea/Legends|Belsallian Sea]] on [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]]. It was located ten [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] from [[Otoh Dooku]].
